description: Paste a stamp made with capture_stamp onto a map with its top-left corner at (x, y). The whole stamp must fit inside the map (it is never clipped) and the map must use the same tileset the stamp was captured from. The rectangle is REPLACED on every layer: empty stamp cells erase what was there. Autotile cells (A1-A4) are re-shaped so their edges blend with the surroundings, including the cells next to the stamp; all other tiles, shadow bits and regions are copied as they are. With includeEvents (default true) the stamp's events are added with new ids and moved to the placement; if one would land on a cell that already has an event, nothing is placed and the cells are listed (includeEvents: false places only the tiles). There is no rotate or mirror. A backup of the map is kept.
name: place_stamp
title: Place stamp
